text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo didn't show up for training, so 
while I was searching around for her... I 
found her in the racing game arcade 
corner.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
The girl in 1st place is so annoying! 
She's way too fast, I can't catch up to 
her record at all!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Still... Turbo will neeeever give up! If I 
try my best, I know I can win!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Just like in a race! Right?!
choice_data_list:
...As you are right now, you won't be able 
to win races, you know?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I... I'll apologize, so... No lecture... 
okay? Pretty please?

Twin Turbo seemed to understand. Since she 
showed remorse, I decided to let the 
matter rest.
